name: ONT plasmid validation runtime (wf-clone-validation, medaka, plannotate)
label: starting-point
notes: Runs scripts/provision_wf_clone_runtime.py, which pulls Oxford Nanopore's published images named in config/ngs/wf_clone_validation_v1.8.4.lock.json and builds medaka from apptainer/medaka.def. The script checks each file against the hash in the lock; an image converted on your machine can differ from that hash, and the script then stops. For Canu assembly run the script yourself with --assembly-tool canu. Not yet built from clean by us: expect to fix things.

check_argv:
import json,subprocess,sys,pathlib
lock='config/ngs/wf_clone_validation_v1.8.4.lock.json'
d=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/validate_wf_clone_runtime.py','--lock',lock,'--resolve','containers.cache_dir'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
imgs=[i for i in json.load(open(lock))['containers']['images'] if i.get('assembly_tool')!='canu']
sys.exit(0 if d and all((pathlib.Path(d)/i['cache_file']).is_file() for i in imgs) else 1)
